evidence.note: Blue appears only on the active nav item, progress bar and section eyebrow (a darker blue ink for text); diagram is neutral grey/white.
One blue arrow into the scorer with a blue check badge marks the verified (passing) path; other arrows stay grey.
Blue reward arrow back to the model and blue 'Aligned reinforcement:' label match the blue verified path.
Red arrows and red 'Misaligned reinforcement:' label mark only the cheat/reward-hack path; the check badge stays blue as the scorer's pass state.
Insight pop-over is neutral ink on white; red and blue persist only in the blurred background diagram.

rationale: Blue is confined to focus/active and the verified state, and red is used solely for the misaligned (loss/alarm) path and its label, never as decorative heading colour. Accent-coloured text uses a darker ink than the accent strokes, matching the pass anchor. No colour appears outside its role and the two hues do not clash.
